cd /app && cat > r.py <<'EOF'
import re, math
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x=y=z=0.0
rel_e=True
obj=None
segs={0:[],1:[],None:[]}
zs=set()
def num(tok):
    return float(tok[1:])
for line in open('text.gcode'):
    line=line.strip()
    if not line: continue
    if line.startswith('M486'):
        m=re.match(r'M486 S(-?\d+)',line)
        if m:
            s=int(m.group(1))
            obj=None if s<0 else s
        continue
    parts=line.split()
    c=parts[0]
    if c=='M83': rel_e=True
    elif c=='M82': rel_e=False
    elif c=='G92':
        pass
    elif c in ('G0','G1'):
        nx,ny,nz=x,y,z
        e=0.0
        for p in parts[1:]:
            if p.startswith(';'): break
            k=p[0]
            try: v=float(p[1:])
            except: continue
            if k=='X': nx=v
            elif k=='Y': ny=v
            elif k=='Z': nz=v
            elif k=='E': e=v
        if e>0 and (nx!=x or ny!=y):
            segs[obj].append((x,y,nx,ny,z))
            zs.add(round(z,3))
        x,y,z=nx,ny,nz
    elif c in ('G2','G3'):
        # arc
        nx,ny=x,y; i=j=0.0; e=0.0
        for p in parts[1:]:
            k=p[0]
            try: v=float(p[1:])
            except: continue
            if k=='X': nx=v
            elif k=='Y': ny=v
            elif k=='I': i=v
            elif k=='J': j=v
            elif k=='E': e=v
        cx,cy=x+i,y+j
        r=math.hypot(x-cx,y-cy)
        a0=math.atan2(y-cy,x-cx); a1=math.atan2(ny-cy,nx-cx)
        if c=='G2':
            while a1>=a0: a1-=2*math.pi
        else:
            while a1<=a0: a1+=2*math.pi
        N=max(4,int(abs(a1-a0)/0.1))
        px,py=x,y
        for s in range(1,N+1):
            a=a0+(a1-a0)*s/N
            qx,qy=cx+r*math.cos(a),cy+r*math.sin(a)
            if e>0: segs[obj].append((px,py,qx,qy,z))
            px,py=qx,qy
        x,y=nx,ny
print(len(segs[0]),len(segs[1]),len(segs[None]))
print(sorted(zs)[:20], max(zs))
for key,name in [(0,'obj0'),(1,'obj1')]:
    fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(12,12),dpi=110)
    for (a,b,cc,d,zz) in segs[key]:
        ax.plot([a,cc],[b,d],color='k',lw=0.5)
    ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.invert_yaxis() if False else None
    fig.savefig(name+'.png',bbox_inches='tight')
    plt.close(fig)
EOF

exec(open('r.py').read().split("print(len(segs")[0])
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=np.array([[s[0],s[1],s[4],s[2],s[3],s[4]] for s in segs[0]])
pts=np.vstack([S[:,:3],S[:,3:]])
c=pts.mean(0)
u,sv,vt=np.linalg.svd(pts-c,full_matrices=False)
e1,e2,n=vt[0],vt[1],vt[2]
def proj(P): 
    d=P-c; return np.c_[d@e1,d@e2]
A=proj(S[:,:3]); B=proj(S[:,3:])
print('extent',A.min(0),A.max(0),'normal',n)
for flip,name in [((1,1),'pcaA'),((-1,1),'pcaB'),((1,-1),'pcaC'),((-1,-1),'pcaD')]:
    fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(22,4),dpi=140)
    for a,b in zip(A,B):
        ax.plot([a[0]*flip[0],b[0]*flip[0]],[a[1]*flip[1],b[1]*flip[1]],'k-',lw=0.7)
    ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
    fig.savefig(name+'.png',bbox_inches='tight'); plt.close(fig)
